items.headline: FMRB executive order Sunday cycle: legal long-reads sharpen the State Farm vector; NSA + MSTIC witnesses added
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday the Knight First Amendment Institute and EFF filed a Saturday amicus letter joining the AI Policy Institute / R Street / Public Knowledge / Lawyers for Civil Justice coalition pressing a 60-day Defense Production Act Section 708 public-comment window plus a documented State Farm reasoned-decision record, and the May 15 14:00 EDT classified threshold briefing in S-407 firmed up with NIST Director Locascio, the ODNI cyber lead, and a CISA Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative representative attending. Today Lawfare publishes a former NIST CAISI policy lead's Sunday long-read laying out the absent-APA-comment-window argument as the dispositive litigation vector if the EO ships on the Section 708 vehicle without notice-and-comment, and Just Security argues the EU AI Office / UK AISI plus Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI MoCs establish a customary-international-practice baseline making any US-side regime mirror them or sit as an outlier. Senator Warner's office adds two May 15 witnesses: the NSA Cybersecurity Directorate director and a Microsoft Threat Intelligence Center representative covering Mythos-class exposure on enterprise tenants. OSTP holds its line that the draft remains in interagency review.

items.headline: Indo-Pacific reciprocity perimeter doubles to eight named candidates with India and Taiwan
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday South Korea PIPC plus the Ministry of Science and ICT signaled formal-mirror intent with a 90-day domestic-consultation window targeting July signature, and New Zealand GCSB confirmed observer status with a Q3 2026 mirror commitment, lifting the perimeter to six named jurisdictions on a single Saturday. Today India's MeitY plus CERT-In publish a joint Sunday note signaling formal-observer entry under a 180-day consultation window pegged to the March AI Advisory with a Q4 2026 mirror-signature target, and Taiwan's National Institute of Cyber Security confirms observer entry under Track II shoulder-to-shoulder arrangements with the US AISI bilateral channel. The cohort now spans eight named candidates (Singapore, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand formally; Canada, Australia, India, Taiwan as observers) plus the UK and EU as the originating pair. The US recognition gap widens by another weekend cycle.

items.headline: Cerebras CBRS Sunday buyside cycle: Morgan Stanley raises to $192, Jefferies initiates Buy at $178
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday post-trade reflection held Morgan Stanley, Goldman, and Citi initiation Buys at $165-$185 with Bernstein adding a Market-Perform at $172 citing Saudi Aramco Digital MoU dependency; CBRS specialty arbitrage logged first-day 38,400-call vs 9,200-put skew. Today Morgan Stanley's Sunday Equity Research weekly raises CBRS target to $192 from $185 on a higher AI-accelerator-revenue multiple band, Goldman holds $185 but layers a $220 upside scenario tied to a Saudi Aramco Digital MoU close in Q3, Bernstein keeps $172 Market-Perform but moves the single-counterparty-concentration risk into its own subheading, and Jefferies initiates new coverage at Buy with a $178 target citing Wormhole Galaxy rack momentum plus the May 8 SEC Corp Fin sample comment letter as removing the Reg FD overhang. CBRS options open interest now sits at approximately 51,200 calls versus 14,700 puts (3.5x call-skew) into Monday's session.

items.headline: Tenstorrent and SambaNova syndicate widen; Saudi PIF contingent secondary surfaces for Groq
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday Tenstorrent filed a confidential S-1 with the SEC late Friday under the JOBS Act EGC framework with Hyundai plus Samsung Foundry as co-anchors and an early-August public window, while SambaNova confirmed J.P. Morgan and Citi as joint lead bookrunners alongside Goldman targeting a late-June confidential submission at a $7-9B fully-diluted range, and Groq remained 30-60 days behind pending sovereign-cloud Saudi terms. Today Tenstorrent's Sunday investor-relations note adds Citi as joint lead bookrunner alongside the previously-engaged J.P. Morgan and Morgan Stanley plus adds Mizuho Securities and SMBC Nikko as Asia-Pacific co-managers reflecting the Hyundai and Samsung Foundry co-anchor positions. SambaNova confirms Wells Fargo Securities joining the syndicate alongside J.P. Morgan, Citi, and Goldman; the syndicate width signals broader-distribution intent. A Sunday Reuters Asia wire references early discussions of a Saudi Public Investment Fund contingent secondary offering for Groq's Saudi-anchored capital structure.

items.headline: Mag-7 print-cycle Sunday preview names May 21 Alphabet analyst day as operative pricing event
items.diff_narrative: Today's Sunday cycle introduces a fresh story-thread that did not appear as a separate frame yesterday: a 247 Wall St Mag-7 Sunday valuation circular combines Alphabet's $9B incremental Iowa Gemini-cluster capex from the May 7 Q1 print with the May 8 SEC Corp Fin sample comment letter on AI-services-revenue measurement basis, naming the May 21 Alphabet analyst day as the operative pricing event for the Mag-7 AI Services 10-Q footnote breakout probability. VentureBeat's Sunday analyst-day preview adds that Wells Fargo Securities now expects Alphabet to ship a Q2 AI Services footnote shape mirroring Microsoft's previously-guided fiscal Q1 2027 breakout, accelerating the cohort timeline. The Saturday Bernstein / Wells Fargo / Evercore ISI mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K cadence probabilities continue to hold, with the Cerebras IPO comparable as the Q2-print reference.

items.headline: Ni8mare day-ten scan: exposed instances drop to ~5,700; unpatched share falls to 38 percent
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday Shadowserver's day-nine scan dropped exposed pre-1.121.0 n8n instances to approximately 6,800 (-18.1 percent in 24 hours) with 44 percent of residual instances still unpatched, while Censys honeypot telemetry showed exploitation attempts tapering from the 4.8x post-KEV spike to approximately 2.9x baseline. Today's day-ten scan continues the descent to approximately 5,700 (-16.2 percent in 24 hours), with the US cohort dropping to 1,920 (from 2,310) and the India cohort to 1,015 (from 1,160). The unpatched share on the residual long tail falls to 38 percent. Aikido's Sunday telemetry note shows exploitation attempts holding at approximately 2.9x baseline awaiting Monday-open commodity-tier kit activity. CISA refreshes the KEV-catalog entry with a Sunday-edition reminder of the May 21 federal-civilian deadline; the NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist holds.

items.headline: AutoGen and Semantic Kernel CVE wave extends Microsoft agent stack into the May 8 survey pattern
items.diff_narrative: Today opens a new branch of the agentic-platform CVE wave that yesterday did not surface: AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9) is a checkpoint-deserialization vulnerability in the agent-state-replay path allowing arbitrary code execution from a malicious checkpoint uploaded via a connected message broker, patched same-day in AutoGen v0.5.18, and Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4) is an authenticated server-side request forgery in the plugin-manifest fetcher allowing pivot to internal cloud-metadata endpoints, patched in v1.36.0 with an out-of-band dotnet packaging advisory. Trail of Bits publishes a joint write-up noting both CVEs follow the same agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern catalogued in the May 8 CrewAI + Haystack survey. The wave now extends across Microsoft's open-source agent stack.

items.headline: MCP-server attack-surface widens its protected-vs-unprotected gap; Defender quarantine reaches 28 percent
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday the third weekly telemetry placed exposed MCP servers at approximately 10,400 with 24 percent of net-new servers on Defender-protected estates quarantined within 30 minutes; Cisco-Astrix MCP-server identity gateway hit 740 enterprise tenants in 48 hours; Sysdig's weekend addendum reported median time-from-provisioning to first credential-extraction attempt of 19 minutes on unprotected estates versus 4.3 hours on Defender-protected. Today Sysdig's Sunday addendum drops the unprotected-estate median to 14 minutes (Defender-protected stays at 4.3 hours), widening the gap by 23 percent in one cycle. Wiz Research's parallel weekly summary places exposed servers at approximately 9,800, Defender quarantine at 28 percent, and Cisco-Astrix identity-gateway tenancy at 920 (+24 percent vs Saturday). Cross-vendor control-plane visibility holds above 65 percent.

items.headline: Claude Code 3.0 day-three telemetry: 17,200 skills, 29 Mythos quarantines, 44 gated tenants
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday day-two consolidation lifted published skills to 13,800 (+21 percent over day one) with 891K installs across the second 24 hours, 22 Mythos-class auto-quarantines, and 41 enterprise tenants opted into Mythos Preview gating after Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, and Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 signed the contractual rider. Today day-three lifts published skills to 17,200 (+24.6 percent) and installs to 1.46M across the third 24 hours (a 64 percent acceleration). Auto-quarantines climb to 29, of which 11 trace to the original six rider-signing tenants. Three additional sovereign-cloud tenants (BAE Systems UK, Rheinmetall AG Germany, Thales SA France) sign the rider on Sunday, lifting the gated cohort to 44. Simon Willison's Sunday note documents the per-tenant attestation log audit-trail review as repeatable across all 44 gated tenants.

items.headline: Hyperscaler registry interop pulls into public preview; AWS-OpenAI lands ahead of Q3 GA
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday Microsoft Skill Catalog added Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry interop in public preview; AWS Bedrock Agent Registry added OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise interop in private preview for FedRAMP-Moderate tenants; Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center extended the model-card schema to include the Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity attestation field. Today AWS Bedrock Agent Registry's OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise interop moves from private preview to public preview for FedRAMP-Moderate tenants ahead of the previously-communicated Q3 GA window; Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center adds parallel public-preview interop with the Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry covering signed-skill provenance plus per-tenant Mythos-class capability gating composition rules; Microsoft Azure AI Foundry Skill Catalog adds South Korea PIPC and New Zealand GCSB cyber-eval reciprocity attestation fields. The three-hyperscaler parallel landing now mirrors all six Indo-Pacific reciprocity-cohort jurisdictions inside one weekend.

items.headline: Mistral Workflows day-ten lands second sovereign-cloud reference at Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday day-nine landed France DGFiP for tax-return anomaly-detection routing as the first central-tax-administration sovereign-cloud reference, lifting paid tenancy to 296 customers (vs 290 Friday) and daily executions to 4.4M, with a Workflows-Codestral integration note showing per-step token-budget bookkeeping interoperates with the OpenAI Codex CLI agent Plan-Apply mode export format. Today day-ten lands Germany's Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit (Federal Employment Agency) for unemployment-claim anomaly-detection routing across the federal employment-services estate, citing the same control-plane separation plus sovereign-cloud execution-worker procurement deciders. Paid tenancy crosses 304 customers; daily executions reach 4.7M. The Workflows-Codestral integration now interoperates bidirectionally with both the OpenAI Codex CLI Plan-Apply export and the Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 signed-export format, closing the cross-vendor orchestration interop matrix.

items.headline: Unsloth router-only LoRA gets second community reproduction on dual RTX 5090; ships NCCL, ONNX, Triton refinements
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday Unsloth's router-only LoRA recipes saw their first community reproduction on a single RTX 6000 Ada workstation running Kimi K2.6 with 14 percent peak VRAM and 76 percent accuracy recovery, alongside a Saturday changelog adding a quantization-aware mode trimming peak VRAM by 19 percent and a Hugging Face PEFT compatibility shim. Today a Sunday Hacker News write-up documents a successful Mixtral 8x22B router-only run on a dual RTX 5090 workstation (64GB combined VRAM via NCCL) with 12 percent peak combined VRAM and 74 percent accuracy recovery on the in-domain finance-news classification eval. Unsloth's Sunday changelog adds a multi-GPU NCCL backend for consumer dual-GPU workstation tiers, an ONNX export path that removes the PEFT runtime dependency for inference deployment, and a Triton kernel optimization that trims router-attention-step latency by 22 percent on Llama 4 Behemoth and Kimi K2.6.

items.headline: Tenstorrent Galaxy second-wave rack shipments add Vultr; bridge round closes with Vy/Atomico/Founders Fund
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday Tenstorrent confirmed first Galaxy production-rack shipments to CoreWeave (8), Lambda Labs (6), Crusoe (4), and Hyundai Robotics Metaplant (3), with Bain Capital Ventures and Fidelity Management joining the closed $3.4B IPO bridge as new investors and the AIwire three-vendor roadmap reconciliation aligning Cerebras CS-4 / Nvidia Vera Rubin / AMD Helios capacity additions. Today Tenstorrent confirms second-wave production-rack shipments adding 5 racks to CoreWeave (total 13), 4 to Lambda (total 10), 3 to Crusoe (total 7), 4 first-wave to Vultr, and 2 additional to Hyundai Metaplant (total 5). Jim Keller's Sunday investor-relations note confirms the bridge round fully closed with Bain Capital Ventures, Fidelity Management, Vy Capital, Atomico, and Founders Fund finalizing pro-rata participation; the confidential S-1 review remains on track for an early-August public-filing window. AMD Helios + MI450 commitment book passes 7.0GW after a 0.8GW Tencent Cloud + 1.0GW Alibaba Cloud Sunday confirmation.

items.headline: Multi-tenant MCP capability-attestation theorem extends Saturday leakage-freedom proof
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday Verifiable Per-Tenant Capability Attestation for MCP Tool-Call Graphs (arxiv 2605.05933) landed as a formal-verification framework for the per-tenant Mythos-class capability gating shipped in Claude Code 3.0 plus the OpenAI per-org agent registry, proving a no-cross-tenant-information-leakage property, co-authored by MIT CSAIL, ETH Zurich, and Anthropic. Today Multi-Tenant MCP Tool-Call Graph Verification with Formal Composition Rules (arxiv 2605.06012) extends that paper with a multi-tenant generalization providing compositional safety theorems across nested tenant boundaries, enabling formal verification of sovereign-cloud plus FedRAMP-Moderate plus per-org-agent-registry deployment shapes; the authorship adds Microsoft. Self-Generated Process Critique Decomposition for Math Reasoning (arxiv 2605.06034) follows up the May 9 Process-Reward-Free RL paper with a decomposition framework reporting a further 1.8-2.4 percent absolute gain when critiques are organized into the formal chain-of-verification structure. DeepMind also ships a v3 ablation on the new Unsloth multi-GPU NCCL backend, demonstrating router-aware advantage decomposition composes cleanly on dual RTX 5090 commodity hardware for context lengths up to 96K tokens.

items.headline: Atlas commercial roster Sunday: Dangjin clean full week; LG Holland activates 24 hours early on Galaxy LoRA fine-tune
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday Tesla Optimus Gen 3's first 12 of 240 units began Fremont cell-pickup pilot work within a 1.4x human-baseline cycle-time envelope, Hyundai Steel Dangjin reported all 60 Atlas units active on rolling-mill pickup, Kia Slovak Zilina completed a first paint-line A-pillar shift cycle with no MTBF-impacting incidents, LG Energy Solution Holland was targeted for Monday activation, and Hyundai Metaplant's 3-rack Tenstorrent allocation was provisioned for a Tuesday first Atlas LoRA fine-tune via the Unsloth router-only recipe. Today the first 12 Optimus Gen 3 units complete a full 8-hour shift cycle on cell-pickup plus torque-fastening at a 1.2x envelope. Dangjin posts a zero-MTBF clean-full-week milestone; Kia Zilina completes a second full shift; LG Holland activates Sunday afternoon (24 hours ahead of plan) with 18 of 30 units on cell-stacking inspection. Hyundai Metaplant's first per-task Atlas LoRA fine-tune is now executing on the Galaxy rack using Unsloth's multi-GPU NCCL backend with first results expected Tuesday.
